Unified Cartographic and Interactive Visualization

Source: R/plot_d4h.R
d4h_plot.Rd

Unified visualization function for drone rasters, grids, vector features, and comparative dual-layer analysis. When comparing two layers (x and y):

  • If interactive = TRUE, renders an interactive side-by-side swipe slider widget (powered by mapview and leaflet.extras2).

  • If interactive = FALSE (default), outputs a publication-ready static comparative panel via ggplot2 and cowplot.

For a single layer: interactive = TRUE produces an interactive mapview web map, while interactive = FALSE produces a static ggplot2 map.

Usage

d4h_plot(
  x,
  y = NULL,
  interactive = FALSE,
  grid = NULL,
  houses = NULL,
  houses_filter_extent = FALSE,
  house_color = "red",
  house_size = 2,
  rgb_bands = NULL,
  palette = "viridis",
  palette_y = "magma",
  limits = NULL,
  limits_y = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  max_pixels = 5e+05,
  zcol = NULL,
  ortho = NULL
)

Arguments

x

SpatRaster, SpatVector, sf, summary data.frame, or character file path to plot (or left layer in comparative mode).

y

Optional SpatRaster, SpatVector, sf, or character path. Right layer for comparative visualization (e.g., comparing NDVI vs NDWI, or Pre vs Post intervention).

interactive

Logical. If FALSE (default), outputs a static ggplot2 plot (or dual-panel comparison if y is provided). If TRUE, outputs an interactive swipe slider (when y is provided) or interactive mapview web map (when single layer).

grid

Optional SpatVector, sf, or character path to overlay grid boundaries.

houses

Optional sf, data.frame, SpatVector, or character path to CSV/Excel containing house coordinates. Automatically plotted as points.

houses_filter_extent

Logical. If TRUE, filters houses to only those intersecting the raster extent / footprint. If FALSE (default), retains all houses.

house_color

Character. Color for house points (default: "red").

house_size

Numeric. Size for house points (default: 2.0).

rgb_bands

Numeric vector of length 3 (e.g. c(1, 2, 3)). If x is a multi-band raster and rgb_bands is specified, renders in true/false RGB.

palette

Character. Color palette name ("viridis", "magma", "terrain", "spectral") or custom color vector (default: "viridis"). For dual comparison, specifies palette for layer x.

palette_y

Character. Color palette for layer y in dual comparative mode (default: "magma").

limits

Numeric vector c(min, max) to fix color scale limits for layer x.

limits_y

Numeric vector c(min, max) to fix color scale limits for layer y.

title

Character. Custom plot title.

max_pixels

Numeric. Maximum number of pixels to render before spatial aggregation (default: 500000).

zcol

Character. Optional column name to color/fill spatial vector features (e.g., "proximity_level", "risk_level", or "dist_water_m").

ortho

SpatRaster or character path. Optional high-resolution RGB orthomosaic to render as an underlay base layer beneath grids, vectors, or point features.

Value

A ggplot object (if interactive = FALSE) or an interactive mapview / leaflet slider widget (if interactive = TRUE).

Examples

# \donttest{
if (interactive()) {
  library(drones4health)
  library(terra)

  ndvi_file <- system.file("extdata", "ndvi.tif", package = "drones4health")
  ndre_file <- system.file("extdata", "ndre.tif", package = "drones4health")

  # 1. Comparative dual-indicator: interactive mapview swipe slider
  d4h_plot(x = ndvi_file, y = ndre_file, interactive = TRUE)

  # 2. Comparative dual-indicator: static publication panel
  p_dual <- d4h_plot(x = ndvi_file, y = ndre_file, interactive = FALSE)
  print(p_dual)

  # 3. Single indicator: static map
  p_single <- d4h_plot(x = ndvi_file, interactive = FALSE)
  print(p_single)
}
# }
